name: roll-text
title: Roll text
description: A label that rolls up to a copy of itself on hover or focus: the console's pace for its lists, the website's for its footer.
use_for: Short links: the website footer, the console's source list and the docs panel's links.
never: Buttons whose label changes, such as Copy and Copied (use TextSwap)
Touch screens: it rolls only where a pointer can rest
body: Put the class `ds-roll-host` on the link or button that holds it: hovering it (where a pointer can rest) or reaching it with Tab rolls the label in 160ms on the console's curve. `pace="console"` moves the label 110% so no sliver shows; `pace="site"` moves it one line, as the website's footer does. Reduced motion holds it still.

examples.label: In the product
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import RollText from '@/components/visuals/RollText.vue'
// The docs panel's links: hover one, or reach it with Tab, and its label rolls at the console's pace.
const links = ['Quickstart', 'Namespaces', 'Search', 'Connect an agent']
const current = ref('Quickstart')
</script>

<template>
  <nav class="flex w-58 flex-col" aria-label="docs">
    <button
      v-for="l in links"
      :key="l"
      type="button"
      class="ds-roll-host relative flex h-control-sm gap-2 cursor-pointer items-center px-2 text-ui text-fg-soft transition-[background-color,color] duration-120 ease-standard hover:bg-surface-subtle hover:text-fg focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 aria-[current=page]:bg-surface aria-[current=page]:font-medium aria-[current=page]:text-fg aria-[current=page]:outline aria-[current=page]:-outline-offset-1 aria-[current=page]:outline-edge max-md:h-11 max-md:text-body"
      :aria-current="current === l ? 'page' : undefined"
      @click="current = l"
    >
      <RollText :text="l" class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left" />
    </button>
  </nav>
</template>

<!-- The docs panel's links: hover one, or reach it with Tab, and its label rolls at the console's pace. -->
<nav class="flex w-58 flex-col" aria-label="docs" id="docs">
  <button type="button" class="ds-roll-host relative flex h-control-sm gap-2 cursor-pointer items-center px-2 text-ui text-fg-soft transition-[background-color,color] duration-120 ease-standard hover:bg-surface-subtle hover:text-fg focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 aria-[current=page]:bg-surface aria-[current=page]:font-medium aria-[current=page]:text-fg aria-[current=page]:outline aria-[current=page]:-outline-offset-1 aria-[current=page]:outline-edge max-md:h-11 max-md:text-body" aria-current="page"><conare-roll-text text="Quickstart" class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left"></conare-roll-text></button>
  <button type="button" class="ds-roll-host relative flex h-control-sm gap-2 cursor-pointer items-center px-2 text-ui text-fg-soft transition-[background-color,color] duration-120 ease-standard hover:bg-surface-subtle hover:text-fg focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 aria-[current=page]:bg-surface aria-[current=page]:font-medium aria-[current=page]:text-fg aria-[current=page]:outline aria-[current=page]:-outline-offset-1 aria-[current=page]:outline-edge max-md:h-11 max-md:text-body"><conare-roll-text text="Namespaces" class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left"></conare-roll-text></button>
  <button type="button" class="ds-roll-host relative flex h-control-sm gap-2 cursor-pointer items-center px-2 text-ui text-fg-soft transition-[background-color,color] duration-120 ease-standard hover:bg-surface-subtle hover:text-fg focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 aria-[current=page]:bg-surface aria-[current=page]:font-medium aria-[current=page]:text-fg aria-[current=page]:outline aria-[current=page]:-outline-offset-1 aria-[current=page]:outline-edge max-md:h-11 max-md:text-body"><conare-roll-text text="Search" class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left"></conare-roll-text></button>
  <button type="button" class="ds-roll-host relative flex h-control-sm gap-2 cursor-pointer items-center px-2 text-ui text-fg-soft transition-[background-color,color] duration-120 ease-standard hover:bg-surface-subtle hover:text-fg focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 aria-[current=page]:bg-surface aria-[current=page]:font-medium aria-[current=page]:text-fg aria-[current=page]:outline aria-[current=page]:-outline-offset-1 aria-[current=page]:outline-edge max-md:h-11 max-md:text-body"><conare-roll-text text="Connect an agent" class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left"></conare-roll-text></button>
</nav>
<script type="module">
  const links = document.querySelectorAll('#docs button')
  for (const link of links) {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
      for (const other of links) other.removeAttribute('aria-current')
      link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page')
    })
  }
</script>
